description:
## Finding
Workspace \`Cargo.toml\` lines 45 and 49 declare:
\`\`\`
p384           = { workspace = true }  # actually: \"0.13\", default-features = false, features = [\"ecdsa\"]
ed25519-dalek  = { workspace = true }  # actually: \"2\", default-features = false
\`\`\`

\`grep -rn \"p384\\|ed25519\" pkix-*/Cargo.toml pkix-*/src/\` returns matches only in two stale comments in \`pkix-path/Cargo.toml\` (covered by separate issue) and zero crate code references. They are dead.

## Why P1
- Section 0 anchor: the workspace \`Cargo.toml\` advertises a feature surface (P-384, Ed25519) that no crate consumes.
- README workspace-level claim \"RustCrypto: RSA, ECDSA P-256\" matches reality and contradicts these dead deps.
- A user reading the workspace manifest will look in the wrong place for P-384/Ed25519 support.

## Fix
Remove \`p384\` and \`ed25519-dalek\` from \`[workspace.dependencies]\` until they are actually used. Same review pass should consider \`signature\` (used only by pkix-composite/pkix-ct stubs).

## Scope reference
\`Cargo.toml:45,49\`.
title: P1: workspace Cargo.toml declares unused p384 and ed25519-dalek deps
